name: window-unconfirmed
description: The caller runs the gate correctly but the callee agrees in the abstract without naming a time. Agreement is not a window, so the chain pauses for a human.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I'm an automated assistant calling on behalf of Amina Otieno, with her permission.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What is the earliest appointment you have with Dr Mwangi?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I'd need to look at the diary, it's not in front of me. Someone will call you about it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm not able to take a call back. When should I call you instead?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yeah, sure, that's fine, whenever suits you really.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Understood. Thank you for your time.
